[[File:Nashal_cloning_facility_interior.jpg|thumb|300px|Cloning technology]]
A small '''cloning facility''' could be found next to the [[Nashal Medical Center|medical center]] in [[Nashal]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

It was situated in a nondescript building. One room featured several beds for patients and a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] to treat them. The other room was below ground and contained the technology necessary to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] beings.

[[Durgur Pyne]], the city's head of security, could often be found here.

==Behind the scenes==
The cloning facility is a place in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It provides players with a place to [[Wikipedia:Spawning (video gaming)|respawn]] ("clone") on Talus after they have been killed. The canonical status of such cloning facilities in ''Star Wars Galaxies'' is unknown.

The same type of building is used for many of the game's cloning facilities.
